resolved_findings.evidence: The actual agent.run compiled graph/executor path was exercised with mocked providers and without mocking _graph.ainvoke. Unknown fusion status remained UNKNOWN, selected-attempt status remained separately ERROR, fusion availability was false, fusion provenance was absent, polarity was null, the typed slot was degraded, and PRIVATE_SENTINEL was absent from the compact summary, internal sentiment_polarity result, typed slot, logs, progress, trace serialization, and Sentry calls.

Direct and full-agent one-model failure, fusion failure, and low-coverage counterexamples preserve trustworthy partial aggregates while exposing explicit availability, missing/degraded flags, model statuses, coverage quality, and contributor-only provenance.

Finite ASCII allowlists bound FinBERT, VADER, fusion and selected-attempt statuses and polarity; unknown, overlong and malformed values become UNKNOWN/null, clear stale contributions, and do not cross compact State or operational telemetry.
Every present published_at and effective_from field is parsed independently and rejected if invalid or later than as_of; no future field can be hidden behind a historical sibling timestamp.
Future same-URL chunks are filtered before document grouping and deduplication, preventing a future chunk from borrowing an eligible timestamp.
ForecastContext and run_id are required in agent and MCP dispatch paths before retriever/provider execution; the missing-identity counterexample proved no provider dispatch.
Allowlisted trace processors, stable error codes, bounded semantic counts, progress events and eight measured lifecycle boundaries remain payload-free with Stage 06 revision 1 attempt 4 identity.
